title: Knowledge Base Management
description: Write self-serve help articles that actually help. Tests technical writing, formatting for readability, and search intent.

seo.overviewTitle: Knowledge Base Article Writing & Self-Service Optimization
seo.overviewBody: Self-service knowledge bases empower customers to resolve questions independently while reducing support ticket volumes. Support leaders evaluate candidates on Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles, writing scannable help articles, optimizing search keywords, and tracking ticket deflection rates.

deliverables.title: 1. Self-Service Knowledge Base Article Library (5 Articles)
deliverables.desc: Formatted help articles featuring clear step-by-step guides, callout boxes, and annotated UI screenshots.

deliverables.title: 2. KCS Content Governance & Maintenance Plan
deliverables.desc: Governance framework establishing article review schedules, authoring standards, and flagging rules for stale content.

deliverables.title: 3. Help Center Search & Ticket Deflection Audit Report
deliverables.desc: Analytics report tracking search terms with zero results, article helpfulness ratings, and deflected ticket volumes.

faqs.question: What are the core principles of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS)?
faqs.answer: KCS integrates knowledge creation directly into the support workflow: capture knowledge in the moment, structure articles for reuse, refine articles based on real demand, and share collective knowledge across the team.

faqs.question: How do you calculate help center ticket deflection rate?
faqs.answer: Ticket Deflection Rate = (Total Help Center Visitors who did NOT submit a ticket / Total Help Center Visitors) * 100.

faqs.question: How should help center articles be structured for scannability?
faqs.answer: Use descriptive H2 headings, short 2-3 sentence paragraphs, numbered lists for sequential steps, bold UI button text, and visual callout boxes for warnings.
